column1: # The reach ledger of the slot matrix (doc/claude/SLOT_MATRIX.md § Keeping it honest): every silent-wrong issue filed
# since the release of 2026-11-03, judged against the matrix as it stood on 2026-11-19.
# Columns, tab-separated: issue, verdict, slot, filler, missing, channel, note.
#   verdict  fits-now (the tables hold the slot and the filler) | fits-rows (a row, a type
#            or a prelude helper is missing) | needs-axis (it turns on something the tool
#            does not vary) | outside (not about evaluating an operand)
#   missing  what the tables or the tool lacked for it

column3: right operand of `&&` holding a call whose first argument is a text call kept ahead of a second hoisted call
column4: a call with two call arguments, one answering text
column7: Interpreter only: the kept text temporary is released at every exit but set only where bound; the crash needs its slot to hold another frame's bytes — an earlier statement that runs on some paths only, which no single-statement cell has.

column3: the end of a record holding a stored reference (a block or scope exit)
column4: a droppable record named by a `reference<T>` field
column7: Two gaps: no prelude type declares OpDrop or a stored reference, and no channel counts hook runs — on main d268b48cc the double drop passes LOFT_LEAK_CHECK and LOFT_POISON (a hook ran twice, no store was freed twice).
